sloka: अर्जुनस्य गदा सा तु पात्यमाना ऽहितोरसि ।काञ्चनाभं नभश्चक्रे विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा ।। ७.३२.५६ ॥
transliteration: arjunasya gadā sā tu pātyamānā 'hitorasi ।kāñcanābhaṁ nabhaścakre vidyutsaudāminī yathā ।। 7.32.56 ॥

translations.english: Arjuna's mace, when struck upon the enemy's (Ravana's) chest, made the sky appear golden-hued, just like a flash of lightning.
